profiles.name: W. N. Hildebrand
profiles.excerpt: Culver City Police Chief W. N. Hildebrand gave Nightwatch its official closing voice, updating listeners on the real people and cases recorded during police ride-alongs.
profiles.bio_html:
W. N. Hildebrand served as chief of police in Culver City, California during the period when Nightwatch recorded actual police calls with reporter Donn Reed. He was not a repertory actor. His authority on the program came from his real law-enforcement position.

At the end of Nightwatch broadcasts, Hildebrand provided follow-up information about the citizens and incidents listeners had heard and encouraged public cooperation with police. That recurring closing role placed him on the air as an official commentator and narrator rather than as a performer playing fictional characters.

Golden Radio Hour currently preserves 38 Nightwatch broadcasts credited to Hildebrand. His public profile is therefore classified with announcers, hosts and narrators while the original episode credit data remains preserved.
